units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘This is the thing which the LORD has commanded:
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them: This is the thing which Jehovah hath commanded, saying,

units.leftText: Whatever man there is of the house of Israel who kills a bull, or lamb, or goat in the camp, or who kills it outside the camp,
units.rightText: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it without the camp,

units.leftText: and hasn’t brought it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as an offering to the LORD before the LORD’s tabernacle: blood shall be imputed to that man. He has shed blood. That man shall be cut off from among his people.
units.rightText: and hath not brought it unto the door of the tent of meeting, to offer it as an oblation unto Jehovah before the tabernacle of Jehovah: blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

units.leftText: This is to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, that they may bring them to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, to the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace offerings to the LORD.
units.rightText: to the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they sacrifice in the open field, even that they may bring them unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, unto the priest, and sacrifice them for sacrifices of peace-offerings unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: The priest shall sprinkle the blood on the LORD’s altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of Jehovah at the door of the tent of meeting, and burn the fat for a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: They shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices to the goat idols, after which they play the prostitute. This shall be a statute forever to them throughout their generations.’
units.rightText: And they shall no more sacrifice their sacrifices unto the he-goats, after which they play the harlot. This shall be a statute forever unto them throughout their generations.

units.leftText: “You shall say to them, ‘Any man there is of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice,
units.rightText: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that offereth a burnt-offering or sacrifice,

units.leftText: and doesn’t bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man shall be cut off from his people.
units.rightText: and bringeth it not unto the door of the tent of meeting, to sacrifice it unto Jehovah; that man shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: “‘Any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who eats any kind of blood, I will set my face against that soul who eats blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
units.rightText: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, that eateth any manner of blood, I will set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

units.leftText: For the life of the flesh is in the blood. I have given it to you on the altar to make atonement for your souls; for it is the blood that makes atonement by reason of the life.
units.rightText: For the life of the flesh is in the blood; and I have given it to you upon the altar to make atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh atonement by reason of the life.

units.leftText: Therefore I have said to the children of Israel, “No person among you may eat blood, nor may any stranger who lives as a foreigner among you eat blood.”
units.rightText: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

units.leftText: “‘Whatever man there is of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners among them, who takes in hunting any animal or bird that may be eaten, he shall pour out its blood, and cover it with dust.
units.rightText: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among them, who taketh in hunting any beast or bird that may be eaten; he shall pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

units.leftText: For as to the life of all flesh, its blood is with its life. Therefore I said to the children of Israel, “You shall not eat the blood of any kind of flesh; for the life of all flesh is its blood. Whoever eats it shall be cut off.”
units.rightText: For as to the life of all flesh, the blood thereof is all one with the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh; for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

units.leftText: “‘Every person that eats what dies of itself, or that which is torn by animals, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the evening. Then he shall be clean.
units.rightText: And every soul that eateth that which dieth of itself, or that which is torn of beasts, whether he be home-born or a sojourner, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

units.leftText: But if he doesn’t wash them, or bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.’”
units.rightText: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh, then he shall bear his iniquity.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.
units.rightText: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do; neither shall ye walk in their statutes.

units.leftText: You shall do my ordinances. You shall keep my statutes and walk in them. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Mine ordinances shall ye do, and my statutes shall ye keep, to walk therein: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and mine ordinances; which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘None of you shall approach any close relatives, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
units.rightText: None of you shall approach to any that are near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father, nor the nakedness of your mother: she is your mother. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy father, even the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife. It is your father’s nakedness.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover; it is thy father’s nakedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, whether born at home or born abroad.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or the daughter of thy mother, whether born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your son’s daughter, or of your daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness; for theirs is your own nakedness.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter, conceived by your father, since she is your sister.
units.rightText: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister. She is your father’s near kinswoman.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s near kinswoman.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother. You shall not approach his wife. She is your aunt.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife. You shall not uncover her nakedness.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter-in-law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife. It is your brother’s nakedness.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They are near kinswomen. It is wickedness.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter; thou shalt not take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; they are near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not take a wife in addition to her sister, to be a rival, to uncover her nakedness, while her sister is still alive.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not take a wife to her sister, to be a rival to her, to uncover her nakedness, besides the other in her life-time.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is impure by her uncleanness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife, and defile yourself with her.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbor’s wife, to defile thyself with her.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not give any of your children as a sacrifice to Molech. You shall not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not give any of thy seed to make them pass through the fire to Molech; neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 18:21 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not lie with a man as with a woman. That is detestable.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down with it: it is a perversion.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith; neither shall any woman stand before a beast, to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

units.leftText: “‘Don’t defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these the nations which I am casting out before you were defiled.
units.rightText: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out from before you;

units.leftText: The land was defiled. Therefore I punished its iniquity, and the land vomited out her inhabitants.
units.rightText: and the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land vomiteth out her inhabitants.

units.leftText: You therefore shall keep my statutes and my ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the native-born, nor the stranger who lives as a foreigner among you
units.rightText: Ye therefore shall keep my statutes and mine ordinances, and shall not do any of these abominations; neither the home-born, nor the stranger that sojourneth among you

units.leftText: (for the men of the land that were before you had done all these abominations, and the land became defiled),
units.rightText: (for all these abominations have the men of the land done, that were before you, and the land is defiled);

units.leftText: that the land not vomit you out also, when you defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.
units.rightText: that the land vomit not you out also, when ye defile it, as it vomited out the nation that was before you.

units.leftText: “‘For whoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.
units.rightText: For whosoever shall do any of these abominations, even the souls that do them shall be cut off from among their people.

units.leftText: Therefore you shall keep my requirements, that you do not practice any of these abominable customs which were practiced before you, and that you do not defile yourselves with them. I am the LORD your God.’”
units.rightText: Therefore shall ye keep my charge, that ye practise not any of these abominable customs, which were practised before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to all the congregation of the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘You shall be holy; for I, the LORD your God, am holy.
units.rightText: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy; for I Jehovah your God am holy.

units.leftText: “‘Each one of you shall respect his mother and his father. You shall keep my Sabbaths. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father; and ye shall keep my sabbaths: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: “‘Don’t turn to idols, nor make molten gods for yourselves. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: “‘When you offer a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, you shall offer it so that you may be accepted.
units.rightText: And when ye offer a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah, ye shall offer it that ye may be accepted.

units.leftText: It shall be eaten the same day you offer it, and on the next day. If anything remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
units.rightText: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if aught remain until the third day, it shall be burnt with fire.

units.leftText: If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;
units.rightText: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination; it shall not be accepted:

units.leftText: but everyone who eats it shall bear his iniquity, because he has profaned the holy thing of the LORD, and that soul shall be cut off from his people.
units.rightText: but every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the holy thing of Jehovah: and that soul shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the corners of your field, neither shall you gather the gleanings of your harvest.
units.rightText: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest.

units.leftText: You shall not glean your vineyard, neither shall you gather the fallen grapes of your vineyard. You shall leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather the fallen fruit of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not steal.
units.rightText: Ye shall not steal; neither shall ye deal falsely, nor lie one to another.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, and profane the name of thy God: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 19:12 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not oppress your neighbor, nor rob him.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not oppress thy neighbor, nor rob him: the wages of a hired servant shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not curse the deaf, nor put a stumbling block before the blind; but you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind; but thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘You shall do no injustice in judgment. You shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but you shall judge your neighbor in righteousness.
units.rightText: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty; but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbor.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbor: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not hate your brother in your heart. You shall surely rebuke your neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thy heart: thou shalt surely rebuke thy neighbor, and not bear sin because of him.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your neighbor as yourself. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people; but thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘You shall keep my statutes.
units.rightText: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with two kinds of seed: neither shall there come upon thee a garment of two kinds of stuff mingled together.

units.leftText: “‘If a man lies carnally with a woman who is a slave girl, pledged to be married to another man, and not ransomed or given her freedom; they shall be punished. They shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
units.rightText: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to a husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; they shall be punished; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

units.leftText: He shall bring his trespass offering to the LORD, to the door of the Tent of Meeting, even a ram for a trespass offering.
units.rightText: And he shall bring his trespass-offering unto Jehovah, unto the door of the tent of meeting, even a ram for a trespass-offering.

units.leftText: The priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he has committed; and the sin which he has committed shall be forgiven him.
units.rightText: And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the trespass-offering before Jehovah for his sin which he hath sinned: and the sin which he hath sinned shall be forgiven him.

units.leftText: “‘When you come into the land, and have planted all kinds of trees for food, then you shall count their fruit as forbidden. For three years it shall be forbidden to you. It shall not be eaten.
units.rightText: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as their uncircumcision: three years shall they be as uncircumcised unto you; it shall not be eaten.
leftNotes: 19:23 literally, “uncircumcised”

units.leftText: But in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, for giving praise to the LORD.
units.rightText: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy, for giving praise unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: In the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, that it may yield its increase to you. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not eat any meat with the blood still in it. You shall not use enchantments, nor practice sorcery.
units.rightText: Ye shall not eat anything with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantments, nor practise augury.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not cut the hair on the sides of your head or clip off the edge of your beard.
units.rightText: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor tattoo any marks on you. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘Don’t profane your daughter, to make her a prostitute; lest the land fall to prostitution, and the land become full of wickedness.
units.rightText: Profane not thy daughter, to make her a harlot; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

units.leftText: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary; I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘Don’t turn to those who are mediums, nor to the wizards. Don’t seek them out, to be defiled by them. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Turn ye not unto them that have familiar spirits, nor unto the wizards; seek them not out, to be defiled by them: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: “‘You shall rise up before the gray head and honor the face of the elderly; and you shall fear your God. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honor the face of the old man, and thou shalt fear thy God: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you in your land, you shall not do him wrong.
units.rightText: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not do him wrong.

units.leftText: The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: The stranger that sojourneth with you shall be unto you as the home-born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were sojourners in the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: “‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
units.rightText: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.

units.leftText: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am Jehovah your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
leftNotes: 19:36 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
19:36 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

units.leftText: “‘You shall observe all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them. I am the LORD.’”
units.rightText: And ye shall observe all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Moreover, you shall tell the children of Israel, ‘Anyone of the children of Israel, or of the strangers who live as foreigners in Israel, who gives any of his offspring to Molech shall surely be put to death. The people of the land shall stone that person with stones.
units.rightText: Moreover, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
leftNotes: 20:2 or, seed

units.leftText: I also will set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people, because he has given of his offspring to Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
units.rightText: I also will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

units.leftText: If the people of the land all hide their eyes from that person when he gives of his offspring to Molech, and don’t put him to death,
units.rightText: And if the people of the land do at all hide their eyes from that man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and put him not to death;

units.leftText: then I will set my face against that man and against his family, and will cut him off, and all who play the prostitute after him to play the prostitute with Molech, from among their people.
units.rightText: then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that play the harlot after him, to play the harlot with Molech, from among their people.

units.leftText: “‘The person that turns to those who are mediums and wizards, to play the prostitute after them, I will even set my face against that person, and will cut him off from among his people.
units.rightText: And the soul that turneth unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto the wizards, to play the harlot after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

units.leftText: “‘Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be holy; for I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy; for I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: You shall keep my statutes, and do them. I am the LORD who sanctifies you.
units.rightText: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth you.

units.leftText: “‘For everyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has cursed his father or his mother. His blood shall be upon himself.
units.rightText: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall surely be put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

units.leftText: “‘The man who commits adultery with another man’s wife, even he who commits adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
units.rightText: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbor’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: “‘The man who lies with his father’s wife has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both of them shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
units.rightText: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: “‘If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death. They have committed a perversion. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
units.rightText: And if a man lie with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: “‘If a man lies with a male, as with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon themselves.
units.rightText: And if a man lie with mankind, as with womankind, both of them have committed abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: “‘If a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness. They shall be burned with fire, both he and they, that there may be no wickedness among you.
units.rightText: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

units.leftText: “‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
units.rightText: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

units.leftText: “‘If a woman approaches any animal and lies with it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death. Their blood shall be upon them.
units.rightText: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: “‘If a man takes his sister—his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter—and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a shameful thing. They shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness. He shall bear his iniquity.
units.rightText: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a shameful thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of the children of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

units.leftText: “‘If a man lies with a woman having her monthly period, and uncovers her nakedness, he has made her fountain naked, and she has uncovered the fountain of her blood. Both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
units.rightText: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath made naked her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

units.leftText: “‘You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister, nor of your father’s sister, for he has made his close relative naked. They shall bear their iniquity.
units.rightText: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister; for he hath made naked his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

units.leftText: If a man lies with his uncle’s wife, he has uncovered his uncle’s nakedness. They shall bear their sin. They shall die childless.
units.rightText: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

units.leftText: “‘If a man takes his brother’s wife, it is an impurity. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness. They shall be childless.
units.rightText: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is impurity: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

units.leftText: “‘You shall therefore keep all my statutes and all my ordinances, and do them, that the land where I am bringing you to dwell may not vomit you out.
units.rightText: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all mine ordinances, and do them; that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, vomit you not out.

units.leftText: You shall not walk in the customs of the nation which I am casting out before you; for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.
units.rightText: And ye shall not walk in the customs of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they did all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

units.leftText: But I have said to you, “You shall inherit their land, and I will give it to you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey.” I am the LORD your God, who has separated you from the peoples.
units.rightText: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am Jehovah your God, who hath separated you from the peoples.

units.leftText: “‘You shall therefore make a distinction between the clean animal and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean. You shall not make yourselves abominable by animal, or by bird, or by anything with which the ground teems, which I have separated from you as unclean for you.
units.rightText: Ye shall therefore make a distinction between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the unclean fowl and the clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by bird, or by anything wherewith the ground teemeth, which I have separated from you as unclean.

units.leftText: You shall be holy to me, for I, the LORD, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that you should be mine.
units.rightText: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I, Jehovah, am holy, and have set you apart from the peoples, that ye should be mine.

units.leftText: “‘A man or a woman that is a medium or is a wizard shall surely be put to death. They shall be stoned with stones. Their blood shall be upon themselves.’”
units.rightText: A man also or a woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones; their blood shall be upon them.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say to them, ‘A priest shall not defile himself for the dead among his people,
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests, the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none defile himself for the dead among his people;

units.leftText: except for his relatives that are near to him: for his mother, for his father, for his son, for his daughter, for his brother,
units.rightText: except for his kin, that is near unto him, for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

units.leftText: and for his virgin sister who is near to him, who has had no husband; for her he may defile himself.
units.rightText: and for his sister a virgin, that is near unto him, that hath had no husband; for her may he defile himself.

units.leftText: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.
units.rightText: He shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

units.leftText: “‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
units.rightText: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

units.leftText: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.
units.rightText: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God; for the offerings of Jehovah made by fire, the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

units.leftText: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.
units.rightText: They shall not take a woman that is a harlot, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

units.leftText: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.
units.rightText: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee; for I Jehovah, who sanctify you, am holy.

units.leftText: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.
units.rightText: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the harlot, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

units.leftText: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.
units.rightText: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head go loose, nor rend his clothes;

units.leftText: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.
units.rightText: neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

units.leftText: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.
units.rightText: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

units.leftText: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.
units.rightText: A widow, or one divorced, or a profane woman, a harlot, these shall he not take: but a virgin of his own people shall he take to wife.

units.leftText: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”
units.rightText: And he shall not profane his seed among his people: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth him.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed throughout their generations that hath a blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

units.leftText: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,
units.rightText: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or anything superfluous,

units.leftText: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,
units.rightText: or a man that is broken-footed, or broken-handed,

units.leftText: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.
units.rightText: or crook-backed, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or is scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

units.leftText: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.
units.rightText: no man of the seed of Aaron the priest, that hath a blemish, shall come nigh to offer the offerings of Jehovah made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

units.leftText: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.
units.rightText: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy:

units.leftText: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
units.rightText: only he shall not go in unto the veil, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

units.leftText: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.
units.rightText: So Moses spake unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto me, and that they profane not my holy name: I am Jehovah.
leftNotes: 22:2 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,
units.rightText: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

units.leftText: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—
units.rightText: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

units.leftText: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.
units.rightText: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.

units.leftText: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
units.rightText: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

units.leftText: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.
units.rightText: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

units.leftText: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
units.rightText: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest’s, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

units.leftText: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.
units.rightText: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

units.leftText: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
units.rightText: And if a priest’s daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.

units.leftText: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.
units.rightText: But if a priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and be returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s bread: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

units.leftText: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
units.rightText: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.

units.leftText: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,
units.rightText: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto Jehovah,

units.leftText: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”
units.rightText: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:
units.rightText: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that offereth his oblation, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill-offerings, which they offer unto Jehovah for a burnt-offering;

units.leftText: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
units.rightText: that ye may be accepted, ye shall offer a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.

units.leftText: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.
units.rightText: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

units.leftText: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
units.rightText: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

units.leftText: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.
units.rightText: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
units.rightText: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath anything superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

units.leftText: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.
units.rightText: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, ye shall not offer unto Jehovah; neither shall ye do thus in your land.

units.leftText: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
units.rightText: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.rightText: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the oblation of an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
units.rightText: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

units.leftText: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
units.rightText: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.

units.leftText: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.
units.rightText: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,
units.rightText: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who halloweth you,
leftNotes: 22:32 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”
units.rightText: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, The set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

units.leftText: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.
units.rightText: Six days shall work be done: but on the seventh day is a sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of work: it is a sabbath unto Jehovah in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.
units.rightText: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their appointed season.

units.leftText: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.
units.rightText: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at even, is Jehovah’s passover.

units.leftText: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.
units.rightText: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto Jehovah: seven days ye shall eat unleavened bread.

units.leftText: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
units.rightText: In the first day ye shall have a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”
units.rightText: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah seven days: in the seventh day is a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring the sheaf of the first-fruits of your harvest unto the priest:

units.leftText: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.
units.rightText: and he shall wave the sheaf before Jehovah, to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

units.leftText: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: And in the day when ye wave the sheaf, ye shall offer a he-lamb without blemish a year old for a burnt-offering unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
units.rightText: And the meal-offering thereof shall be two tenth parts of an ephah of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto Jehovah for a sweet savor; and the drink-offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
leftNotes: 23:13 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
23:13 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

units.leftText: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
units.rightText: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched grain, nor fresh ears, until this selfsame day, until ye have brought the oblation of your God: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.
units.rightText: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave-offering; seven sabbaths shall there be complete:

units.leftText: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.
units.rightText: even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meal-offering unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.
units.rightText: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave-loaves of two tenth parts of an ephah: they shall be of fine flour, they shall be baken with leaven, for first-fruits unto Jehovah.
leftNotes: 23:17 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

units.leftText: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.
units.rightText: And ye shall present with the bread seven lambs without blemish a year old, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be a burnt-offering unto Jehovah, with their meal-offering, and their drink-offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.
units.rightText: And ye shall offer one he-goat for a sin-offering, and two he-lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace-offerings.

units.leftText: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.
units.rightText: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first-fruits for a wave-offering before Jehovah, with the two lambs: they shall be holy to Jehovah for the priest.

units.leftText: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.
units.rightText: And ye shall make proclamation on the selfsame day; there shall be a holy convocation unto you; ye shall do no servile work: it is a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

units.leftText: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”
units.rightText: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them for the poor, and for the sojourner: I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, shall be a solemn rest unto you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

units.leftText: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”
units.rightText: Ye shall do no servile work; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.rightText: Howbeit on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement: it shall be a holy convocation unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And ye shall do no manner of work in that same day; for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.
units.rightText: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day; he shall be cut off from his people.

units.leftText: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.
units.rightText: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any manner of work in that same day, that soul will I destroy from among his people.

units.leftText: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
units.rightText: Ye shall do no manner of work: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

units.leftText: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”
units.rightText: It shall be unto you a sabbath of solemn rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye keep your sabbath.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto Jehovah.
leftNotes: 23:34 or, feast of tents, or Succoth

units.leftText: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.
units.rightText: On the first day shall be a holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.
units.rightText: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: on the eighth day shall be a holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah: it is a solemn assembly; ye shall do no servile work.

units.leftText: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—
units.rightText: These are the set feasts of Jehovah, which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto Jehovah, a burnt-offering, and a meal-offering, a sacrifice, and drink-offerings, each on its own day;

units.leftText: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.
units.rightText: besides the sabbaths of Jehovah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your freewill-offerings, which ye give unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.
units.rightText: Howbeit on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruits of the land, ye shall keep the feast of Jehovah seven days: on the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

units.leftText: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.
units.rightText: And ye shall take you on the first day the fruit of goodly trees, branches of palm-trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before Jehovah your God seven days.

units.leftText: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.
units.rightText: And ye shall keep it a feast unto Jehovah seven days in the year: it is a statute for ever throughout your generations; ye shall keep it in the seventh month.

units.leftText: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,
units.rightText: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are home-born in Israel shall dwell in booths;
leftNotes: 23:42 or, booths
23:42 or, booths

units.leftText: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”
units.rightText: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am Jehovah your God.
leftNotes: 23:43 or, booths

units.leftText: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.
units.rightText: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the set feasts of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
units.rightText: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

units.leftText: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
units.rightText: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations.

units.leftText: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.
units.rightText: He shall keep in order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Jehovah continually.

units.leftText: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.
units.rightText: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts of an ephah shall be in one cake.
leftNotes: 24:5 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

units.leftText: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.
units.rightText: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.
units.rightText: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before Jehovah continually; it is on the behalf of the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.

units.leftText: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
units.rightText: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire by a perpetual statute.

units.leftText: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
units.rightText: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp:

units.leftText: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
units.rightText: and the son of the Israelitish woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him unto Moses. And his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

units.leftText: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.
units.rightText: And they put him in ward, that it might be declared unto them at the mouth of Jehovah.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

units.leftText: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
units.rightText: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

units.leftText: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
units.rightText: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

units.leftText: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.
units.rightText: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the sojourner, as the home-born, when he blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, shall be put to death.

units.leftText: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
units.rightText: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

units.leftText: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
units.rightText: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.

units.leftText: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:
units.rightText: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:

units.leftText: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.
units.rightText: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.

units.leftText: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
units.rightText: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good: and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.

units.leftText: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”
units.rightText: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the sojourner, as for the home-born: for I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.
units.rightText: And Moses spake to the children of Israel; and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses.

units.leftText: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

units.leftText: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.
units.rightText: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto Jehovah.

units.leftText: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
units.rightText: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruits thereof;

units.leftText: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.
units.rightText: but in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a sabbath unto Jehovah: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

units.leftText: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.
units.rightText: That which groweth of itself of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, and the grapes of thy undressed vine thou shalt not gather: it shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

units.leftText: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.
units.rightText: And the sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for thee, and for thy servant and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant and for thy stranger, who sojourn with thee.

units.leftText: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.
units.rightText: And for thy cattle, and for the beasts that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be for food.

units.leftText: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.
units.rightText: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and there shall be unto thee the days of seven sabbaths of years, even forty and nine years.

units.leftText: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.
units.rightText: Then shalt thou send abroad the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month; in the day of atonement shall ye send abroad the trumpet throughout all your land.

units.leftText: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.
units.rightText: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubilee unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

units.leftText: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.
units.rightText: A jubilee shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of the undressed vines.

units.leftText: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.
units.rightText: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

units.leftText: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.
units.rightText: In this year of jubilee ye shall return every man unto his possession.

units.leftText: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.
units.rightText: And if thou sell aught unto thy neighbor, or buy of thy neighbor’s hand, ye shall not wrong one another.

units.leftText: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.
units.rightText: According to the number of years after the jubilee thou shalt buy of thy neighbor, and according unto the number of years of the crops he shall sell unto thee.

units.leftText: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.
units.rightText: According to the multitude of the years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of the years thou shalt diminish the price of it; for the number of the crops doth he sell unto thee.

units.leftText: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.
units.rightText: And ye shall not wrong one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am Jehovah your God.

units.leftText: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.
units.rightText: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep mine ordinances and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

units.leftText: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.
units.rightText: And the land shall yield its fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

units.leftText: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”
units.rightText: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;

units.leftText: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.
units.rightText: then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for the three years.

units.leftText: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
units.rightText: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, ye shall eat the old store.

units.leftText: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.
units.rightText: And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity; for the land is mine: for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

units.leftText: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.
units.rightText: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

units.leftText: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.
units.rightText: If thy brother be waxed poor, and sell some of his possession, then shall his kinsman that is next unto him come, and shall redeem that which his brother hath sold.
